async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the Catalog link in the menubar to expand the menu
    catalog_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Catalog')
    await catalog_link.click()
    # Wait for the menu to expand
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Look for a 'Products' link in the expanded menu
    products_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Products')
    if await products_link.count() > 0:
        await products_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Wait for product grid to load
    else:
        # If 'Products' link not found, try to find it by partial name or other attributes
        all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
        for i in range(await all_links.count()):
            link = all_links.nth(i)
            name = await link.get_attribute('aria-label') or await link.text_content()
            if name and 'product' in name.lower():
                await link.click()
                await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
                await asyncio.sleep(3)
                break
